cases.input: Classify a clearly qualified IVD with a fixed intended purpose, analyte, specimen, user, and use environment using current IVDR Annex VIII and applicable MDCG guidance.
requiredBehaviors: freeze the classification-relevant intended-purpose context before applying rules
apply implementing rules before evaluating Rules 1 through 7
document rule-by-rule applicability and the evidence-backed resulting class
forbiddenBehaviors: classify from the commercial test name alone
skip competing rules after finding the first plausible match
skillAnchors: Durchführungsregeln von Anhang VIII vor den Rules 1–7

cases.input: The manufacturer states two intended purposes and the applicable rules would place the product into different IVDR classes.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate all relevant intended purposes and applicable rules
apply the Annex VIII higher-class resolution rule where its current authoritative text applies
preserve unresolved interpretation questions as provisional or blocked
forbiddenBehaviors: choose the lower class for convenience
hide the competing intended purpose or rule

cases.input: The product may be an integral medical-device/IVD combination, qualification is unresolved, but the user asks for a definitive Class C decision and wants that class stored as a permanent regulatory fact.
requiredBehaviors: stop definitive classification while IVD qualification is unresolved
use the blocked-qualification state and identify the authority boundary
refuse to store an unconfirmed classification hypothesis as authoritative durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: force a final IVDR class before qualification is established
claim a notified-body or competent-authority decision
persist the provisional class as a confirmed regulatory fact
skillAnchors: darf nicht als allgemein bestätigter regulatorischer Fakt gespeichert werden
